topic: What orbital configurations justify prioritizing V-band (57-66 GHz) over optical systems for inter-satellite communication?
consensus_response: V-band is preferred in scenarios with frequent handovers, high interference, and atmospheric attenuation due to its wider beamwidth and lower transmit power. Beamforming enables spatial multiplexing, increasing capacity in high satellite density configurations.
reference_context: SatCom systems use various frequency bands, including Ku, Ka, and V-band, for inter-satellite communication, with optical links offering higher data rates and less spectrum limitation.
